quest.title: Greetings From the Knights of Favonius
quest.description: Amber seems to be looking for you...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x20, Outrider's Champion Steak! x5, Guide to Freedom x3

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Dragonspine can be a cold and miserable place. If you're gonna invite spectators to come and watch an event here, you gotta make it worth their while.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Hopefully, these stalls will keep people entertained and make the atmosphere in the camp more relaxed.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: I'm also taking the chance to hand out some little trinkets for the teams to decorate their tents with.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Here you go — these are for The Soulblazers.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Best of luck in the competition, and don't forget to have fun!
